title: juglans mandshurica f. rugosa
intro: Juglans mandshurica f. rugosa, commonly known as Manchurian walnut, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia, known for its unique, warty bark and edible nuts. The health benefits of Juglans mandshurica f. rugosa include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Juglans mandshurica f. rugosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
